_comment: P1-11 fit-out scope profiles. Inputting only an area used to silently schedule the full trade list as fact. Profiles make the scope assumption explicit; the default remains full scope but is disclosed as ASSUMED_SCOPE with its assumed trades, reused systems and unknowns. Physical-logic exclusions are provisional until a measured takeoff overrides them.

SHELL_TO_CATB.description: Bare shell / Cat A base to full Cat B fit-out.

CAT_A_TO_CATB.description: Cat A landlord base with suspended ceilings/raised floor in place; tenant Cat B on top.
CAT_A_TO_CATB.notes: Cat A scope must be contractually confirmed; reuse list is provisional.

EXISTING_REFURB.description: Refurbishment of an occupied-or-vacant existing fit-out.
EXISTING_REFURB.notes: Demolition fraction is UNKNOWN and must come from --site_condition cat_b_existing or renovation_partial with --demolition_fraction; this profile never invents a strip fraction.

LIGHT_REFRESH.description: Cosmetic refresh: finishes and furniture only.
LIGHT_REFRESH.notes: Existing systems reused as-is; fire/MEP applicability under refresh requires separate authority confirmation.

FULL_RENOVATION.description: Full strip-and-rebuild of an existing fit-out.
FULL_RENOVATION.notes: Requires --site_condition full_strip (or cat_b_existing) for demolition quantities.

CUSTOM.description: User-defined scope; not selectable without an explicit definition.
CUSTOM.not_implemented_reason: A custom scope requires an explicit user-supplied definition; selection is rejected rather than defaulted.
